events.factual_description: Rhizome DC presents ZZZZZZZZZ: Drone All Night from Friday, September 18, 2026 at 6:00 PM through Saturday, September 19 at 6:00 AM at 6950 Maple St NW in Washington, DC. The event expands Rhizome's recurring transcendental sound-dozing format into a 12-hour overnight continuous-sound journey. Rhizome describes a collective sound palette including gong baths, theremins, plant synthesizers, cassette loops, poetry, ambient drones and vinyl DJ sets. Twenty artists are announced across three zones: 6:00-10:00 PM, 10:15 PM-2:00 AM and 2:15-6:00 AM. The detailed official ticket bands are $10-$20 per zone and $30-$50 for an all-night pass; the event-page headline separately says $10-$60, while Rhizome's authorized Pools checkout confirms the detailed $10-$20 and $30-$50 face-value bands. All proceeds support renovations for Rhizome's new home on Alaska Avenue, and the event is supported by a grant from the DC Commission for the Arts & Humanities. Rhizome encourages attendees to bring a mat, sleeping bag or blanket, eye mask and water.

en.why_it_matters: The live format is the argument. Rhizome stretches a recurring sound-dozing idea into a full night, letting drones, gongs, electronics, loops, poetry and vinyl accumulate as an environment rather than a sequence of conventional sets. The audience is invited to sleep inside it, and the three-zone structure makes duration part of the music. With the proceeds feeding Rhizome's next home, the night also captures a local experimental community using sound, space and time as the material.
en.trip_verdict: If Friday night is open in the DMV and the immersive overnight format sounds appealing, this is a distinctive local option; one zone is the easy way in, while the all-night pass is for committing to the full experience. I would not reorganize a regional itinerary around it because the ZZZZZZZZZ format has appeared before and this edition's strength is the local, durational experiment rather than a one-time farewell.

es.why_it_matters: La razón está en el formato en vivo. Rhizome estira una idea recurrente de música para dormitar hasta convertirla en una noche completa, donde drones, gongs, electrónica, loops, poesía y vinilos se acumulan como ambiente en vez de funcionar como una sucesión de sets convencionales. El público puede incluso dormirse dentro de ese paisaje, y la estructura por tres zonas vuelve la duración parte de la música. Además, que la recaudación vaya a la nueva sede de Rhizome convierte la noche en una fotografía bastante clara de una comunidad experimental local trabajando con sonido, espacio y tiempo.
es.trip_verdict: Si el viernes está libre en el DMV y te atrae el formato inmersivo de toda la noche, es una opción local muy distinta; entrar a una sola zona es la forma sencilla de probarla y el pase completo es para quedarse con la experiencia entera. No reorganizaría un itinerario regional alrededor de esta fecha porque el formato ZZZZZZZZZ ya ha tenido otras ediciones y la fuerza de ésta está en el experimento local y duracional, no en una despedida irrepetible.
